thread:
maria: Heads-up — I'm seeing intermittent ECC single-bit spikes and occasional Xid 13s on a couple of eu-central GPU nodes (pool: gpu-cc-eu-3). First noticed at 06:12 UTC.
aj: which hosts/serials?
maria: node-cc-12 (SN: GTCX12345L), node-cc-15 (SN: GTCX12388Z). quick dmesg snippet below: 
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, PID=2721, GPU=0000:65:00
[ 12346.000123] NVRM: GART: page_fault_probe: invalid access, ecc_uerr_count=1
[ 12346.100456] NVRM: ecc single-bit error corrected, channel=3
```
maria: errors are low-volume but persistent across reboots. node-cc-15 also shows elevated corrected ECC counts in `nvidia-smi -q`.
devin: can you paste the `nvidia-smi -q | grep -A3 -i 'ecc'` output?
maria: pasted below:
```
GPU 0: ecc errors 
   Single-bit ECC errors (Volatile): 42 
   Double-bit ECC errors (Aggregate): 0
```
aj: 42 corrected ECCs is noteworthy but not immediate double-bit. Could be warming up. Any recent thermal events?
maria: ambient temps ok, fan profiles normal. saw 2 thermal throttle events last week on node-cc-12 but not correlated.
sneha: tagging this for vendor escalation. we need to decide: hold and monitor vs swap. spare inventory in region? @warehouse
warehouse: spare pool for eu-central currently has 2 full-length 80GB blades (spare-bin-eu-3). We prefer not to deplete both in one go.
aj: operationally, we should drain node-cc-15 first (higher ECC) and leave node-cc-12 in reduced power-cap mode for 48h to see trend. if node-cc-12 crosses 100 corrected ECCs in 24h then escalate to swap.
devin: agree. set power cap to 250W and move batch jobs off node-cc-15 now. I'll create a cordon/drain playbook.
aj: also create vendor ticket in parallel. we need RMA window and pickup. please include serials and logs. @vendor-liaison can you open the case?
vendor-liaison: opened ticket VND-84219 with vendor (NVIDIA partner). ETA for depot pickup: 48-72h pending customs. I attached dmesg + nvidia outputs.
vendor-liaison: vendor asked for manifest with: serial, host asset tag, failure log, and preferred depot (AMS).
sneha: AMS depot ok, but customs sometimes slow. can we request courier hand-carry for faster return? cost estimate?
warehouse: hand-carry will add ~€400 per unit, needs approval from finance. spare pool will be reserved if RMA accepted.
devin: temporary mitigation steps applied:
```bash
# set power cap
nvidia-smi -i 0 -pl 250
# mark node unsched for new jobs
sudo scontrol update NodeName=node-cc-15 State=DRAIN Reason="flaky-ecc-flag-1725009999"
```
devin: eviction of running jobs in progress, ETA 15m.
oncall-bot: Incident candidate created: INC-2024-9482 — "eu-central GPU ECC drift on gpu-cc-eu-3". Pager notified to infra-oncall.
maria: logs and recent pod/core allocations pinned in the incident doc. I added per-gpu corrected-ECC time-series to the dashboard.
aj: planning notes:
- drain node-cc-15 and ship if vendor confirms depot pickup.
- keep node-cc-12 in reduced cap for 48h, monitor trend.
- if another host shows >50 corrected ECC in 24h, preemptively tag for swap.
- allocate 1 spare to immediate replacement from spare-bin-eu-3, keep 1 as contingency.
sneha: I'll draft the manifest for the vendor and attach the asset tags + RMA pics once QA snapshots taken.
vendor-liaison: vendor replied: need full host power logs and BIOS dump for both nodes. please upload to the ticket. vendor assigned SR# SR-707122.
maria: uploading /var/log/nvidia and fw dumps now to the ticket.
aj: update finance on potential hand-carry and pre-approve up to €1k per incident for expedited RMAs. @finance? (cc: @people-ops not needed)
warehouse: noted — reserving 1 spare in spare-bin-eu-3, shipping hold until vendor confirms pickup.
sneha: quick question: should we rotate serials in CMDB to indicate 'under-RMA' status? that helps schedulers avoid allocation.
aj: yes, update CMDB + set label in asset manager: status=RMA_PENDING, location=holding-AMS.
maria: after drain completed, node-cc-15 will have logs and QA snapshots in /opt/rma/snapshots/1725009999.
devin: drain finished, jobs migrated. node-cc-15 is powered down and ready for pickup. please confirm manifest and courier.
vendor-liaison: courier scheduled for pickup 2024-05-12 08:00 UTC. tracking CN-PRIO-5559. vendor expects replacement window 5-7 business days.
aj: thanks. I'll close the monitoring loop: if node-cc-12 trend worsens we'll expedite. otherwise re-open thread for more RMAs. :thumbsup:
maria: noted. leaving dashboard alerts at medium sensitivity. :eyes:
notes: thread covers detection, triage, temporary mitigations, spare allocation, vendor RMA ticketing, courier/finance coordination, and CMDB asset updates. contains logs and runbook snippets.
